params.body:
The footer credit moves from the Trendwolves link to the company line at the bottom, where the street address was.

## Footer

- The Trendwolves link reads "A Trendwolves product", the same as on the cover.
- The bottom line reads "© 2026 Trendwolves NV", "Developed by Maarten Leyts", "VAT BE 0882.982.288", then the email and phone, as before.
- `x-company-line` takes an optional `credit`, shown in place of the address. Without it the line is unchanged.

## Where the address stays

- The pre-launch cover keeps the full line. A cover without a sender was read as phishing by a web filter, and `PreLaunchTest` guards that.
- The contact page and the terms still give the address, so a buyer or payment provider can still find it.

## Tests

`FooterCreditTest`: the footer names the developer once, has no street address, keeps the VAT number, and the contact page still gives the address. The full suite passes apart from BuildStampTest, which fails in any worktree.
params.title: Footer: developer credit in the place of the address
